# commander_classic_pam_cloud (Resource)

Creates and manages a **classic PAM cloud record** with **per-user share permissions** in your Keeper vault.

A PAM Cloud record represents a cloud resource, identified by its **URL** and **account identifier**.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example 1 - Minimal: only required fields (title)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "commander_classic_pam_cloud" "minimal" {
  title = "PAM Cloud - aws-prod"
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example 2 - All cloud fields + share permissions
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "commander_classic_pam_cloud" "full_fields" {
  title              = "PAM Cloud - aws-prod"
  url                = "https://console.aws.amazon.com"
  account_identifier = "123456789012"
  notes              = "Production AWS account."
  folder_location    = "_REPLACE_WITH_SHARED_FOLDER_UID_"

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Per-user share permissions (optional).
  # Map key = user email. Each value is { can_share, can_edit }.
  # Both flags default to false (view-only).
  # Omit the block entirely to skip share reconciliation.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  share = {
    "alice@example.com" = {
      can_share = true
      can_edit  = true
    }
    "bob@example.com" = {
      can_edit = true
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) **Title** of the PAM cloud record.

### Optional

- `account_identifier` (String) **Account identifier** of the cloud resource.
- `folder_location` (String) Folder **UID** or path to store PAM cloud record in your Keeper vault. If not provided, the record will be stored in the root path of vault.
- `notes` (String) **Notes** for this PAM cloud record.
- `share` (Attributes Map) Mapping of share permissions for this record. Each map **key** is a **user email**; each **value** is an object with `can_share` and `can_edit` booleans. The owner is implicit and never present in this map; the API rejects owner entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--share))
- `url` (String) **URL** of the cloud resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The PAM cloud record **UID** assigned by Keeper after create.

<a id="nestedatt--share"></a>
### Nested Schema for `share`

Optional:

- `can_edit` (Boolean) Allow the user to edit this record. Defaults to `false`.
- `can_share` (Boolean) Allow the user to re-share this record with other users. Defaults to `false`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import is supported. Import ID is the vault record UID of the PAM cloud record.
terraform import commander_classic_pam_cloud.full_fields "AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUw"

# Or use the import block in configuration:
# import {
#   to = commander_classic_pam_cloud.full_fields
#   id = "AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUw"
# }
#
# After import, run terraform plan and align configuration with remote state
# (title, url, account_identifier, notes, share, etc.).
```
